title: Stickman Battle: An open-source real-time Python code-combat arena [MIT License]
author: Delicious-Editor-168
selftext:
>Hi everyone! I've built **Stickman Battle**, an open-source browser combat game where players write Python logic (if-else, distance sensors, trigonometry spells) to duel autonomous AI bots or classmates in live 1v1 matches.  
>  
>**Tech Stack:** Python 3 (Flask), Flask-SocketIO (60 FPS real-time physics), HTML5 Canvas, and an AST security sandbox.  
>  
>🐙 **GitHub (Source Code):** [https://github.com/SHAYAK-ARROW/Stickman-Battle](https://github.com/SHAYAK-ARROW/Stickman-Battle)  
🎮 **Play in Browser:** [https://arrows-dev.itch.io/stickman-battle](https://arrows-dev.itch.io/stickman-battle)  
>  
>It's 100% free under the MIT license. Feedback and code contributions are very welcome!
